title: Helpdesk & Ticketing System
tagline: Every support request tracked, assigned and resolved — nothing left buried in an inbox.
overview: A helpdesk turns support emails, chats and calls into tracked tickets with a clear owner, a status and a deadline — replacing the shared inbox where requests quietly go unanswered because nobody was technically responsible for them.
features: Omnichannel ticket intake — email, chat, phone and social in one queue
Automated ticket routing and priority assignment
SLA tracking with escalation alerts before deadlines slip
Knowledge base and customer self-service portal
Canned responses and macros for common requests
Agent performance and ticket volume reporting

process.title: Support Workflow Audit
process.desc: We map how requests currently arrive, who handles them and where things tend to stall.

process.title: Queue & Routing Setup
process.desc: Ticket queues, priority rules and auto-assignment are configured around your actual team structure.

process.title: Knowledge Base Migration
process.desc: Existing help docs and FAQs are migrated and organized into a searchable self-service portal.

process.title: Go-Live & Agent Training
process.desc: We train your support team on the new workflow and tune SLA rules based on real ticket patterns.

benefits.title: Faster first response
benefits.desc: Automated routing gets tickets to the right agent immediately instead of sitting unclaimed in a shared inbox.

benefits.title: Nothing falls through the cracks
benefits.desc: Every request becomes a tracked ticket with an owner and a status, so none quietly go unanswered.

benefits.title: Clear accountability per ticket
benefits.desc: SLA tracking and escalation alerts mean a stalled ticket gets flagged before the customer has to chase it.

faqs.q: Can it handle support requests from multiple channels?
faqs.a: Yes — email, live chat, phone and social messages all land in one unified queue rather than separate inboxes.

faqs.q: Can customers find answers without contacting an agent?
faqs.a: Yes, the self-service knowledge base is searchable and can resolve common questions before a ticket is ever created.
Escalation alerts notify the relevant manager before a deadline is missed, not after, so there's time to react.

testimonial.quote: Tickets used to disappear into a shared inbox and nobody owned them. Now every request has a name attached and a clock running.
testimonial.author: Client Name

title: Live Chat & Messaging
tagline: Answer the question a customer has right now, not an hour after they've already left.
overview: Live chat puts a real-time conversation directly on your storefront and app, so a customer with a question before checkout gets an answer in the moment instead of abandoning the cart to go email support and wait.
features: Real-time website and in-app chat widget
Proactive chat triggers based on visitor behavior
Chatbot deflection for common, repetitive questions
Seamless handoff from bot to human agent mid-conversation
Multi-agent queue with skill-based chat routing
Chat transcripts synced automatically to the helpdesk

process.title: Chat Flow Audit
process.desc: We review your current support channels and where customers tend to abandon before reaching a human.

process.title: Widget & Trigger Setup
process.desc: The chat widget and proactive triggers are configured for the pages and moments that matter most to conversion.

process.title: Bot & Routing Configuration
process.desc: Chatbot deflection handles repetitive questions, with clear handoff rules for when a human agent should step in.

process.title: Go-Live & Agent Training
process.desc: We train agents on the queue and tune bot responses based on real conversations in the first weeks.

benefits.title: Fewer abandoned carts
benefits.desc: A question answered in real time at checkout is a sale kept, instead of a cart abandoned while waiting on email.

benefits.title: Faster resolution for simple questions
benefits.desc: Chatbot deflection closes out common questions instantly, freeing agents for the conversations that actually need a person.

benefits.title: Better conversion from live engagement
benefits.desc: Proactive triggers reach hesitant visitors at the right moment instead of waiting for them to seek out a contact form.

faqs.q: Does the chatbot replace human agents entirely?
faqs.a: No — the bot deflects common, repetitive questions and hands off to a human agent the moment a conversation needs one.

faqs.q: Can chat transcripts be reviewed later?
faqs.a: Yes, every conversation syncs to the helpdesk automatically, so there's a full record tied to that customer's ticket history.

faqs.q: Can we control when the chat widget appears?
faqs.a: Yes, proactive triggers are configurable by page, time on site or visitor behavior, so chat shows up when it's actually useful.

testimonial.quote: We used to lose people at checkout over questions that took thirty seconds to answer. Now someone's there before they even think about leaving.
testimonial.author: Client Name
